lcc_original: 過了四十天，挪亞打開他所造的樓船的窗戶；
notes: LCC uses 打開 for פָּתַח (H6605) instead of UNV's 開了; H6605+WTH8799 attached after 打開
LCC uses 樓船 for תֵּבָה (H8392) instead of UNV's 方舟; H8392 attached to 樓船

UNV implicit {<WAH0834>}{<WH06213>}{<WTH8804>} are explicit in LCC as 他所造的: H0834 (אֲשֶׁר relative pronoun) attached to 他 as the relative clause introducer; H6213+WTH8804 (עָשָׂה 'made') attached to 造
H01961 (וַיְהִי) remains implicit — LCC begins with 過了 (covering מִקֵּץ) without rendering the existential/temporal frame verb
H0853 (אֵת direct object marker) remains implicit — no explicit Chinese word corresponds to it
The 的 after 所造 is a Chinese relativizing particle with no Hebrew correspondent; left unannotated
